parameters.content:
## 01_CHANNEL_Telegram (Fase 3-4)

Recibe mensajes de Telegram, identifica empresa(s), muestra el menu diario, recolecta las
respuestas del modo automatico (cantidad/redes/tipo) y, al terminar, genera de verdad las
publicaciones con Gemini (Content Planner + Creative + Copywriter combinados en un solo paso
por ahora), las guarda como borradores en content_items, y registra el costo en agent_logs.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO processed_events (platform, external_id, event_type)
VALUES ('telegram', $1, 'message')
ON CONFLICT (platform, external_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

SELECT COALESCE(
  json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name) ORDER BY c.id),
  '[]'::json
) AS companies
FROM company_social_accounts sa
JOIN companies c ON c.id = sa.company_id
WHERE sa.platform = 'telegram'
  AND sa.account_ref = $1
  AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE';

INSERT INTO conversations (company_id, platform, channel_ref, last_customer_message_at, context_state_json, active_flow)
VALUES (NULL, 'telegram', $1, now(), '{}'::jsonb, NULL)
ON CONFLICT (platform, channel_ref)
DO UPDATE SET last_customer_message_at = now()
RETURNING id, context_state_json, active_flow;

SELECT
  seed.cid AS company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  b.description, b.sector, b.tone, b.colors_primary, b.colors_secondary, b.visual_style,
  b.phone, b.whatsapp_number, b.logo_path, b.logo_background,
  b.city, b.address, b.email, b.website, b.accent_color, b.background_color, b.logo_description,
  b.forbidden_visuals_json, b.social_handles_json, b.words_avoid_json,
  b.target_age, b.target_location, b.target_interests,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', s.name, 'description', s.description, 'price', s.price, 'currency', s.currency)) FROM company_services s WHERE s.company_id = seed.cid AND s.active), '[]'::json) AS services,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', s.id, 'name', s.name, 'labels_i18n', s.labels_i18n_json)) FROM company_services s WHERE s.company_id = seed.cid AND s.active), '[]'::json) AS services_full,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name', p.name, 'description', p.description, 'price_before', p.price_before, 'price_after', p.price_after, 'currency', p.currency)) FROM company_promotions p WHERE p.company_id = seed.cid AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'), '[]'::json) AS promotions,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(r.rule_text) FROM company_rules r WHERE r.company_id = seed.cid AND r.active), '[]'::json) AS rules
FROM (SELECT $1::text AS cid) AS seed
LEFT JOIN company_brand b ON b.company_id = seed.cid
LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = seed.cid;

UPDATE conversations
SET context_state_json = $1::jsonb, active_flow = $2
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING $4::text AS chat_id, $5::text AS reply_text;

WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO content_items (company_id, content_type, platform, concept, headline, caption, cta, hashtags_json, alt_text, image_prompt, visual_json, template_key, status)
  SELECT
    $1,
    $2,
    d->>'platform',
    d->>'concept',
    d->>'headline',
    d->>'caption',
    d->>'cta',
    COALESCE(d->'hashtags', '[]'::jsonb),
    d->>'alt_text',
    d->>'image_prompt',
    d->'visual',
    d->>'template_key',
    'GENERATED'
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($3::jsonb) AS d
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS inserted_count,
  (SELECT min(id) FROM inserted) AS first_item_id,
  $1::text AS company_id,
  $2::text AS content_type,
  $3::text AS drafts_json,
  $4::integer AS input_tokens,
  $5::integer AS output_tokens,
  $6::numeric AS estimated_cost,
  $7::text AS chat_id,
  $8::text AS reply_text,
  $9::text AS new_state,
  $10::text AS new_flow,
  $11::bigint AS conversation_id,
  $12::text AS formato,
  $13::text AS modo_imagen;

WITH logged AS (
  INSERT INTO agent_logs (company_id, workflow, agent, action, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, estimated_cost, status)
  VALUES ($1, '01_CHANNEL_Telegram', 'content_planner_creative_copywriter', 'generate_draft_posts', $2, $3, $4, $5, 'SUCCESS')
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  $6::text AS chat_id,
  $7::text AS reply_text,
  $8::text AS new_state,
  $9::text AS new_flow,
  $10::bigint AS conversation_id
FROM logged;

SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
  'id', sub.id,
  'content_type', sub.content_type,
  'platform', sub.platform,
  'headline', sub.headline,
  'status', sub.status,
  'created_at', to_char(sub.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
) ORDER BY sub.created_at DESC), '[]'::json) AS recent_items
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM content_items WHERE company_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5
) sub;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: (JSON.parse($('Guardar borradores').item.json.drafts_json)[0] || {}).image_prompt || 'professional clean modern scene, no text, no logo, no people', resolution: '1k', aspect_ratio: ({ cuadrado: '1:1', vertical: '4:5', story: '9:16' }[$('Guardar borradores').item.json.formato] || '1:1'), output_format: 'jpg' }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE content_items
SET generated_image_url = $1, status = 'VALIDATED'
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING
  $3::text AS chat_id,
  $4::text AS reply_text,
  $5::text AS new_state,
  $6::text AS new_flow,
  $7::bigint AS conversation_id,
  $1::text AS image_url,
  $8::text AS image_caption;

WITH job AS (
  UPDATE image_jobs
  SET status = $9::text, generated_count = CASE WHEN $9::text = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
      actual_usd = $10::numeric, actual_cop = $11::numeric, error_detail = $12::text, updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $13::bigint
  RETURNING id
), logged AS (
  INSERT INTO agent_logs (company_id, workflow, agent, action, model, estimated_cost, cost_cop, job_id, status, error_detail)
  SELECT $1, '01_CHANNEL_Telegram', 'image_agent', 'generate_image', $14::text, $10::numeric, $11::numeric, $13::bigint,
         CASE WHEN $10::numeric > 0 THEN 'SUCCESS' ELSE 'ERROR' END, $12::text
  WHERE $13::bigint IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  $2::text AS chat_id,
  $3::text AS reply_text,
  $4::text AS new_state,
  $5::text AS new_flow,
  $6::bigint AS conversation_id,
  $7::text AS image_url,
  $8::text AS image_caption;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Guardar borradores').item.json.company_id, $json.chat_id, $json.reply_text, $json.new_state, $json.new_flow, $json.conversation_id, $json.image_url, $json.image_caption, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.job_status, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.cost_usd, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.cost_cop, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.error_detail, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.job_id, $('Preparar imagen').item.json.model] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(estimated_cost) FROM agent_logs
            WHERE agent = 'image_agent' AND status = 'SUCCESS'
              AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date), 0) AS gasto_hoy_usd,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(estimated_cost) FROM agent_logs
            WHERE agent = 'image_agent' AND status = 'SUCCESS'
              AND date_trunc('month', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') = date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')), 0) AS gasto_mes_usd,
  (SELECT value_json FROM system_config WHERE key = 'image_cost_control' AND company_id IS NULL) AS cost_control,
  (SELECT value_json FROM system_config WHERE key = 'image_price_table' AND company_id IS NULL) AS price_table,
  (SELECT value_json FROM system_config WHERE key = 'format_registry' AND company_id IS NULL) AS format_registry,
  (SELECT value_json FROM system_config WHERE key = 'image_generation_enabled' AND company_id IS NULL) AS image_generation_enabled,
  (SELECT value_json FROM system_config WHERE key = 'image_provider' AND company_id IS NULL) AS image_provider;

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO image_jobs (company_id, idempotency_key, chat_id, update_id, output_kind, provider, model, image_size,
                          quantity, estimated_cop, estimated_usd, dry_run, status, brief_json)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::bigint, 'single', 'gemini', $5, $6, 1, $7::numeric, $8::numeric, false, 'GENERATING', $9::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS job_id, ((SELECT count(*) FROM ins) = 1) AS claimed;
